runtimeTransferDelta.hostInvocation: After the SDK release cases, the host helper starts the existing pinned Noble runtime-deps image. It mounts only candidate-destination/runtime-transfer as /input read-only, standalone runtime_verify.py as /verify.py read-only, and the result directory; it forwards existing PostgreSQL and image identity environment variables.
runtimeTransferDelta.interface: Helper --bundle /input --output /result/evidence matches the standalone verifier. Consumer full mode produces all six sqlite/postgresql/server/grpc/mcp/combined graphs; each graph has relative executable/file paths, actual artifact hashes, expected checks, provider rows and its bound AOT ELF audit. The runtime verifier consumes those fields and removes inherited LD_LIBRARY_PATH.
runtimeTransferDelta.relocation: The transfer writer uses graph/B24Consumer and per-graph relative file inventories. The verifier resolves them under the relocated bundle with canonical-path and symlink-containment checks; it does not reopen producer host-only native build paths.
runtimeTransferDelta.runtimeScope: Verifier checks no dotnet/Cargo/Rust/clang/cc, exact pinned image identity, exact transferred hashes, actual AOT process exit and graph-specific operation receipts, including existing PostgreSQL. The same combined artifact is invoked for SQLite and PostgreSQL; no provider-by-protocol rebuild cross product is added.
runtimeTransferDelta.evidenceAndPublication: build.yml now retains artifacts/task07/B24/runtime/evidence/. Public candidate retention remains only artifacts/packages/. SDK and Noble image identities are written under the existing B24 evidence directory.
runtimeTransferDelta.limit: Only the runtime handoff writer/consumer interface and helper change were reviewed here. This is not a full independent audit of the new functional consumer or negative cases. Actual CI and Noble runtime receipts are still required by the existing chosen scope.
